methodology.workload: Four synthetic stepwise goals on a stateful local fixture: search-and-open, exact-variant add-to-bag, two-cheapest, and a three-field delivery form.
methodology.policy: One batched typed decision per step: operation plus speculative per-operation targets, supplied-value and done/destructive Nouls in a single request. Done requires deterministic done-when checks evaluated in code.
methodology.comparison: Real Jev (typesafe) decisions, same loop and fixtures; measures stepwise verified success and per-step timing.
methodology.timing: taskMs covers navigation start through the last durable completion write inside the attempt; context setup, provider settlement and cleanup are reported separately. Per-step snapMs/pickMs/actMs/settleMs are independent component medians.
methodology.cost: Jev estimated at $0.042 per million input tokens, zero output charge; all attempted calls retained, unknown usage never zero.
methodology.limits: Max 30 steps, 40 actions, 40 model calls, $0.05 known-spend per attempt; stop cohort on accounting failure.
